segments.oily: One reviewer with extremely oily skin reports the patches stay on well and absorb impurities, unlike some other brands that do not stay put on oily skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report the patches do not irritate their skin, and several call the lack of fragrance a plus for sensitive skin.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report the patches visibly flatten whiteheads and pull out pus or gunk overnight, working best on whiteheads that are already coming to a head; several say results are slower or absent on deeper, less-developed, or cystic pimples, and two reviewers (including a parent using them on a teen's acne) saw no visible difference at all.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report visibly reduced redness and swelling around blemishes by morning, describing calmer-looking skin after overnight wear.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers credit the patches with reducing dark marks and hyperpigmentation left behind by healed pimples, including one who says she normally scars after breakouts but did not with this product.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers describe the patches, formulated with niacinamide and zinc, as calming and supporting barrier repair rather than just covering the blemish.

aspects.libelle: Not enough patches for frequent breakouts

extraits.texte: I got these and I was so happy to try them out but I was really disappointed in the results. I washed my face and put one on a pimple I had and left it on overnight, when I pulled it off in the morning there was no visible difference in the pimple. The patch didn't have any sort of pus on it either. When I use mighty patches you can see where the patch pulls out the pus and I can always see a difference in my pimple by the morning time. I tried another one throughout the day and it was no different, do not recommend.

I let my son use these since he currently has been dealing with acne and they didn't help at all . He said they literally did nothing . The packaging was basic. He said they didn't have a scent . He said they felt weird . So we wouldn't recommend or buy them .

This is the first time I've used them, and it's confusing how to apply a patch... you can't feel that you're wearing it. The next day I removed it, and I feel like it didn't extract the pus because the pimple reappeared during the day. It has no smell, it doesn't sting, and the price is cheap.

I used it for different acne whitehead spots. I forgot to post day one to after day three of using it for one spot. I liked how the patches blended in with my skin and worked its magic. I would put it on during night so I slept with it on. It brought the whitehead down and didn't leave my face with a red mark where the whitehead used to be. I never tried patches like this before but I would add it to my routine especially when I feel a whitehead appearing. I would have used these a lot in my youth for sure. I have sensitive skin and was surprised that it didn't irritate my skin.

Tried the Differin Power Patch Skin Restore and really liked it—they stick well, feel comfortable, and actually help calm and heal spots faster. Only thing I'd change is the packaging, for the amount of patches you get, it feels like a lot of extra material. Otherwise, solid product that does what it promises.

extraits.titre: These worked wonder on my pregnancy acne!
extraits.texte: Being pregnant, my face has been breaking out terribly. I put one on the breakout spot (white heads only) and overnight the inflammation and buildup are gone. They gently pop the pimple for expression and leave no residue. I haven't noticed any scarring on blemishes, and I ALWAYS scar after breakouts. 100% worth the price, don't have to use more than twice!

The packaging is compact and hygienic, with individually sealed patches that make them easy to grab and travel with. They work well for calming and protecting blemishes while they heal, and I noticed less redness and irritation after using them overnight. For the price, you get a decent amount of patches, making it a good value compared to some other acne patch brands. The ingredients are gentle and skin-friendly, focusing on soothing and barrier repair rather than harsh drying agents. There's no noticeable scent, which is great for sensitive skin. Overall, they're an effective, fuss-free option for speeding up blemish recovery.
